text:
sara: Quick check — planning a rolling bump to v2.4.1 today before cutoff. Branches synced?
jamie: main has the bump PR open, changelog draft at #452. CI is running, saw one flaky in infra-integration-tests.
mike: which flaky? I can triage. Link?
jamie: infra-integration-tests::session-timeout — fails intermittently on mac-11 runners. Logs: ```ERROR: Timeout waiting for socket
stack: client.connect -> wait_for_ready -> timeout
``` Tried requeue, passed once then flaked again.
olivia: I muted that test in the flaky-annotate job yesterday but didn't land the mute on release branch. Can do a quick PR to mute on release/v2.4.
priya: If we mute, add a note in changelog under Known Issues. Also +1 the changelog PR before I cut the tag.
sara: I'd prefer to avoid muting unless it's noise. What's impact on green-sweep time?
ci-bot: nightly-green-sweep: 3/5 shards passed, 2 failing (infra-integration-tests, metrics-e2e). Average runtime 42m.
mike: metrics-e2e is a separate flaky — looks like timing issue in prometheus scrape in the ephemeral cluster. I'll look now.
jamie: For the bump: can we gate the tag until we have 2 consecutive green runs or a triage note with a plan?
priya: +1 on gating. I'll wait for two green runs or a clear mitigation plan. Will unblock if someone volunteers to own the post-release fix within 24h.
olivia: I'm around today, can own infra-integration test investigation and PR to either mute or fix. ETA 3h.
sara: thanks. If olivia can own, i'm fine with one green + owner commit and then we cut with a follow-up ticket.
jamie: changelog PR updated with Known Issues section and owner tag @olivia. Needs one more reviewer.
mike: pinging @sara for quick review on the bump PR and @priay for changelog approval.
sara: reviewing now, small nit on the migration notes. Will push a tiny edit.
ci-bot: CI run 1745010200: premerge checks passed on linux/amd64 shards, mac shard still flaky.
jamie: mac flaky is the one mentioned. olivia taking it.
olivia: opened PR release/v2.4.1-mute-infra-test (small skip for mac). Link: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pull/489
priya: approving changelog. +1
sara: tag cut plan: wait for ci-bot green run or merge release/v2.4.1-mute-infra-test. If still flaky after 60m, proceed with tag and a hotfix ticket assigned to olivia.
jamie: sounds good. I'll coordinate the tag when CI shows green across required shards.
mike: FYI I re-ran metrics-e2e with extended timeout; it passed locally. I'll add a retry wrapper in the job.
olivia: PR up, tests rerunning on mac CI. Will report back in this thread.
ci-bot: CI run 1745011402: all required shards passed. Status: GREEN. Details: https://ci.internal/runs/1745011402
sara: awesome. jamie let me know when you cut the tag, i'll update release notes and announce in #announcements.
jamie: Tag v2.4.1 created and pushed. Release notes published. :tada:
sara: thanks team. Follow-up tickets: INFRA-782 (investigate mac flaky), INFRA-783 (metrics-e2e retry). Assigned to olivia and mike respectively. Closing loop.
ci-bot: deploy-notify: rollout to prod scheduled in 30m.
